name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a reverse proxy and web server for three sites, including virtual hosts, static content, HTTPS, security hardening, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis for application caching, including Redis authentication, runtime directories, logging, service enablement, and configuration management.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application from GitHub with a Python virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user provisioning, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
